correctness.rationale: Boundary equations give exactly two clipping curves for every positive interior correlation parameter. One-sided limits of the conditional derivative give positive jumps j_L and j_H. The continuous mixed derivative has an explicit positive lower bound on the middle strip. Uniform marginal integration gives each singular graph mass -s log(s)/(2(1-s)), with s=rho^2; the remaining law has planar density. Reflection and parameter endpoints close all cases. Finite exact-rational/numerical checks supplement this analytic proof; no finite experiment is used to infer the universal result.

value.rationale: For a natural published dependence copula, an exact 46.21% singular fraction at moderate r=1/2 shows that pure-density simulation/integration/likelihood treatments can miss substantial mass. The theorem identifies precisely the conditional atoms, graph supports and total masses at every parameter including negative correlations and endpoint degeneracies. This is a structural decomposition with direct probability-model consequences, not a restatement of the smooth interior derivative.
